Through real-world case studies and practical implementation guides, this book provides researchers, engineers, and decision-makers with actionable tools to accelerate the transition toward a more sustainable and resilient industrial landscape. By providing a hands-on, practical guide with Python code snippets and real-world examples, it aims to inspire readers to “think outside the chart.” It fosters a mindset that transcends mere data processing, encouraging readers to unlock the full potential of data through innovative design and to create visuals that inform, delight, and engage audiences long after the numbers have been crunched.
